scope: Complete bounded static read of prospective independent postmerge closeout; no top-level execution, network observation, tests or Git/GitHub mutation.
checks: Current trusted base/branch, exact reviewed tree/sole parent, configured six-owner counts and issue states.
Requires actual completed postmerge receipt/log/count/coverage and topic absence, rather than interpreting preparation as runtime success.
Actual merged PR, five role-specific exact runs and complete paginated live jobs; retained hosted receipt is corroborated, not latest unrelated run.
Clean detached owned checkout and local/remote topic absence; original-main and unrelated-skill byte/mode/symlink inventory recomputed using pinned snapshot helper and retention tag.
No publication or Git mutation; only unique external final JSON/Markdown written after all assertions.
limitations: Static disposition does not assert runtime inputs currently exist or that merge, branch deletion, five hosted runs, final main sync or preservation has occurred.
Remote observations are time-bounded and not atomically locked.
Live job-set comparison to gh run view deliberately fails closed if the latter is incomplete; final runtime must inspect any mismatch rather than treating it as success.
